newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner says RCCL confirms ship order.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner says RCCL confirms ship order.

text.p: Industrial group Kvaerner ASA said on Thursday Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd exercised its option for a second 130,000 ton cruise ship and signed an option for a third.
Kvaerner said the vessels would be the largest cruise ships afloat, with the first two to be delivered in 1999 and 2000 and the third delivered a year later, should the option be taken.

"A recent stream of new orders for our shipbuilding business area has pushed the order book a further $1.6 billion over the last four months," Kvaerner said in a statement released here. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
